keywords_en: Paradex moved out of L2BEAT's rollup category over "privacy perps"
a Domain Architecture for Diamonds ERC merged
summary_en: donnoh_eth said that after Paradex introduced "privacy perps", users rely on a 3 member privacy council to decrypt blobs when needed, security equal to a 3/3 DAC, so it left the rollup category. Lighter published its prover code. clowestab submitted moving ERC-7828 to Draft.
